mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_consultation_event ( conversation_id user_id, intent, response_status, question_excerpt, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{intent}, #{responseStatus}, #{questionExcerpt}, #{occurredAt} )

INSERT INTO ai_safety_report ( report_key, report_type, status, user_id, trigger_event_id, occurrence_count, count_window_started_at, count_window_ended_at ) VALUES ( #{reportKey}, #{reportType}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{triggerEventId}, #{occurrenceCount}, #{countWindowStartedAt}, #{countWindowEndedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE occurrence_count = GREATEST( occurrence_count, VALUES(occurrence_count) ), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, family_id, name, recipient_age, has_previous_gifts, previous_gift_amount, previous_gift_date, deduction_renewal_date FROM vw_family_previous_gift WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY family_id

SELECT user_id, family_id, name, recipient_age, has_previous_gifts, previous_gift_amount, previous_gift_date, deduction_renewal_date FROM vw_family_previous_gift WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, pv.product_name AS productName, p.product_type AS productType, bir.base_rate_percent AS baseRatePercent, pref.preferential_condition AS preferentialCondition FROM kb_product p JOIN kb_product_version pv ON pv.product_id = p.product_id AND pv.sales_status = 'ON_SALE' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT kb_product_version_id, base_rate_percent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY kb_product_version_id ORDER BY min_month ASC ) AS rn FROM base_interest_rate ) bir ON bir.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id AND bir.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT kb_product_version_id, GROUP_CONCAT(preferential_condition SEPARATOR ', ') AS preferential_condition FROM preferential_interest_rate GROUP BY kb_product_version_id ) pref ON pref.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id WHERE pv.kb_product_version_id IN ( SELECT MAX(kb_product_version_id) FROM kb_product_version WHERE sales_status = 'ON_SALE' GROUP BY product_id ) AND p.product_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS')

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, pv.product_name AS productName, e.tracking_index AS trackingIndex, e.annual_return_5y AS annualReturn5y FROM kb_product p JOIN kb_product_version pv ON pv.product_id = p.product_id AND pv.sales_status = 'ON_SALE' JOIN etf e ON e.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id WHERE pv.kb_product_version_id IN ( SELECT MAX(kb_product_version_id) FROM kb_product_version WHERE sales_status = 'ON_SALE' GROUP BY product_id ) AND p.product_type = 'ETF'
